title: 1812 Caracas earthquake
text: The 1812 Caracas earthquake took place in Venezuela on March 26 at 4:37 p.m. It measured M 7.7. The earthquake caused extensive damage in Caracas, La Guaira, Barquisimeto, San Felipe, and Mérida. An estimated 15,000–20,000 people perished as a result, in addition to incalculable material damage.
